verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh does run automations (screening configurations, agentic workflows, workflow webhooks), so this axis applies. However, the pack has no evidence of versioning, change review, or rollback for those automations. The API versioning policy covers vendor endpoint versions, and the case audit trail covers cases rather than automation definitions, so neither counts toward this story. The Starter Plan also says agent configurations cannot be customized.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
